final_answer.summary: Resolved the hinted LUAD cBioPortal study and returned TP53 mutation prevalence plus exemplar variants and co-mutation context.

result.brief_interpretation: TP53 is altered in just over half of LUAD cases in this cohort, with truncating/splice events plus recurrent hotspot missense changes; large-gene co-mutations like TTN suggest high mutation burden, while KRAS provides a driver-level co-mutation example.
